candidates.title: OpWeave: Flexible Operator Disaggregation for Heterogeneous LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Operator-level disaggregation with analytical cost model, joint partition/deployment planning, and vLLM runtime; strong heterogeneous serving contribution.

candidates.title: Calibrate, Then Route: A Measured Study of Learned Request Routing for Disaggregated LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Hardware-calibrated routing for P/D-disaggregated serving validated on eight A40 GPUs with vLLM/NIXL; directly relevant to routing/SLO scheduling.

candidates.title: MAPS: Memory-Aware Predictive Scheduling Framework for Large Language Model Serving
candidates.reason: Memory-aware predictive scheduling for disaggregated LLM serving; relevant to KV pressure and latency-aware placement.

candidates.title: ExaServe: Large-Scale LLM Serving on Exascale HPC Systems
candidates.reason: Reproducible LLM serving deployment to 256 Aurora nodes/3072 vLLM replicas, exposing scaling and control-plane bottlenecks; valuable HPC systems evidence.
